notes: Account background: Pelago provides an immutable call archive + analytics layer for BPOs and enterprise contact centers. Their product indexes recordings for fast search and compliance recall.

Primary ask: automated post-call summaries that produce a structured 3-part output: 1) 3–5 bullet executive summary, 2) QA checklist with scores, 3) 2–3 coaching highlights and suggested phrasing for agent follow-up.

Latency & throughput: need streaming summaries for live coach feed (near-real-time, summaries within 8–12s after call end) and batch nightly processing for 100k calls/day. Peak concurrency: target sustained 4k concurrent streams during campaign peaks.
Tooling: want Redwood tool-calling to create/update Zendesk tickets, push summary + tags to CRM, and trigger coaching workflows. Must support idempotent calls and retry logic.
Security: SSO via SAML already required, strict audit/logging, customer-managed KMS preferred for private deployment. EU data residency mandatory for two major customers.

Cost sensitivity: moderate — willing to commit to reserved capacity if 40–50% unit-cost savings vs current provider; looking for Optimize recommendations (batching, KV cache) to reduce token spend on transcripts.
